title: Netting required.
officialText:
Where it is possible for the public to pass under, or next to, runways or ramps, the space between the
top rail and the toeboard shall be enclosed with a wire screen composed of not less than No. 18 steel wire gage, or equivalent
synthetic netting that is flame retardant in accordance with NFPA 701, with openings in the wire or synthetic mesh no larger than
½ inch (13 mm).
